SELECT SALARY_ID , USER_ID , CODE_DETAIL_NO , SALARY_MIN , SALARY_MAX , TO_CHAR(CREATE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS CREATE_DATE FROM SALARY
SELECT SALARY_ID, USER_ID, CODE_DETAIL_NO, SALARY_MIN, SALARY_MAX, TO_CHAR(CREATE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS CREATE_DATE FROM SALARY WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}

SELECT SALARY_ID, USER_ID, CODE_DETAIL_NO, SALARY_MIN, SALARY_MAX, TO_CHAR(CREATE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS CREATE_DATE FROM SALARY WHERE TO_NUMBER(SALARY_MIN) >= #{salaryMin} AND TO_NUMBER(SALARY_MAX) <= #{salaryMax}

SELECT s.SALARY_ID, s.USER_ID, s.CODE_DETAIL_NO, s.SALARY_MIN, s.SALARY_MAX, TO_CHAR(s.CREATE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS CREATE_DATE FROM SALARY s JOIN COMPANY c ON s.USER_ID = c.USER_ID WHERE c.COM_NAME = #{comName}
mapper.update: UPDATE SALARY SET CODE_DETAIL_NO = #{codeDetailNo}, SALARY_MIN = #{salaryMin}, SALARY_MAX = #{salaryMax}, CREATE_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE SALARY_ID = #{salaryId} AND USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT SALARY_ID , USER_ID , CODE_DETAIL_NO , SALARY_MIN , SALARY_MAX , TO_CHAR(CREATE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS CREATE_DATE FROM SALARY WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY SALARY_ID

SELECT SALARY_ID , USER_ID , CODE_DETAIL_NO , SALARY_MIN , SALARY_MAX , TO_CHAR(CREATE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS CREATE_DATE FROM SALARY WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND CODE_DETAIL_NO = #{codeDetailNo}

WITH salary_data AS ( SELECT s.salary_id, s.user_id, s.code_detail_no, (TO_NUMBER(s.salary_min) + TO_NUMBER(s.salary_max)) / 2 AS salary_mid, s.create_date, s.salary_min, s.salary_max, c.industry_type, c.com_name FROM SALARY s LEFT JOIN COMPANY c ON s.user_id = c.user_id WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} ) SELECT sd.salary_id, sd.user_id, sd.code_detail_no, sd.salary_mid, sd.salary_min, sd.salary_max, sd.create_date, sd.industry_type, sd.com_name,
ROUND( AVG(sd.salary_mid) OVER (), 0) AS salaryAvgAll,
ROUND( AVG( CASE WHEN sd.code_detail_no BETWEEN 'RANK-001' AND 'RANK-006' THEN sd.salary_mid END ) OVER (), 0 ) AS salaryAvgExclExec,
ROUND( AVG( CASE WHEN sd.code_detail_no BETWEEN 'RANK-007' AND 'RANK-011' THEN sd.salary_mid END ) OVER (), 0 ) AS salaryAvgExec,
ROUND( AVG(sd.salary_mid) OVER (PARTITION BY sd.code_detail_no), 0) AS avgByRank
FROM salary_data sd ORDER BY sd.code_detail_no, sd.salary_id

SELECT C.INDUSTRY_TYPE AS INDUSTRY_TYPE, C.COM_NAME AS COM_NAME, C.COM_MEM AS COM_MEM, C.COM_LOGO AS COM_LOGO, C.USER_ID AS USER_ID,
ROUND( AVG( CASE WHEN s.CODE_DETAIL_NO BETWEEN 'RANK-001' AND 'RANK-006' THEN (TO_NUMBER(s.SALARY_MIN) + TO_NUMBER(s.SALARY_MAX)) / 2 END ), 0 ) AS salaryAvgExclExec,
ROUND( AVG( (TO_NUMBER(s.SALARY_MIN) + TO_NUMBER(s.SALARY_MAX)) / 2 ), 0 ) AS salaryAvgExec
FROM COMPANY c
LEFT JOIN SALARY s ON c.USER_ID = s.USER_ID
WHERE c.INDUSTRY_TYPE = #{industryType}
GROUP BY c.INDUSTRY_TYPE, c.COM_NAME, c.COM_MEM, C.COM_LOGO, c.USER_ID
ORDER BY salaryAvgExclExec DESC, c.COM_NAME

SELECT c.INDUSTRY_TYPE, c.COM_NAME, c.COM_MEM, c.COM_LOGO, c.USER_ID, ROUND( AVG( CASE WHEN s.CODE_DETAIL_NO BETWEEN 'RANK-001' AND 'RANK-006' THEN (TO_NUMBER(s.SALARY_MIN) + TO_NUMBER(s.SALARY_MAX)) / 2 END ), 0 ) AS salaryAvgExclExec, ROUND( AVG((TO_NUMBER(s.SALARY_MIN) + TO_NUMBER(s.SALARY_MAX)) / 2), 0 ) AS salaryAvgExec FROM COMPANY c LEFT JOIN SALARY s ON c.USER_ID = s.USER_ID WHERE c.INDUSTRY_TYPE = #{industryType} GROUP BY c.INDUSTRY_TYPE, c.COM_NAME, c.COM_MEM, c.COM_LOGO, c.USER_ID HAVING ROUND( AVG( CASE WHEN s.CODE_DETAIL_NO BETWEEN 'RANK-001' AND 'RANK-006' THEN (TO_NUMBER(s.SALARY_MIN) + TO_NUMBER(s.SALARY_MAX)) / 2 END ), 0 ) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY salaryAvgExclExec DESC, c.COM_NAME

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT c.INDUSTRY_TYPE, c.COM_NAME, c.COM_MEM, c.COM_LOGO, c.USER_ID, ROUND( AVG( CASE WHEN s.CODE_DETAIL_NO BETWEEN 'RANK-001' AND 'RANK-006' THEN (TO_NUMBER(s.SALARY_MIN) + TO_NUMBER(s.SALARY_MAX)) / 2 END ), 0 ) AS salaryAvgExclExec, ROUND( AVG((TO_NUMBER(s.SALARY_MIN) + TO_NUMBER(s.SALARY_MAX)) / 2), 0 ) AS salaryAvgExec, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ROUND( AVG( CASE WHEN s.CODE_DETAIL_NO BETWEEN 'RANK-001' AND 'RANK-006' THEN (TO_NUMBER(s.SALARY_MIN) + TO_NUMBER(s.SALARY_MAX)) / 2 END ), 0 ) DESC, c.COM_NAME ) AS salary_rank FROM COMPANY c LEFT JOIN SALARY s ON c.USER_ID = s.USER_ID WHERE c.INDUSTRY_TYPE = #{industryType} GROUP BY c.INDUSTRY_TYPE, c.COM_NAME, c.COM_MEM, c.COM_LOGO, c.USER_ID HAVING AVG( CASE WHEN s.CODE_DETAIL_NO BETWEEN 'RANK-001' AND 'RANK-006' THEN (TO_NUMBER(s.SALARY_MIN) + TO_NUMBER(s.SALARY_MAX)) / 2 END ) IS NOT NULL ) ranked WHERE ranked.USER_ID = #{userId}
